title: Utilization Spectroframe - Cluster/Pool Daily Export (2026-08-18)
content:
PURPOSE:
This sheet is an automated daily export from the Spectroframe dashboard showing per-cluster, per-pool utilization signals and derived headroom metrics for 2026-08-18. Intended for on-call, capacity planners, and the autoscaler tuning working group. Highlights anomalies and quick mitigation suggestions at the top.

DEFINITIONS:
- avg_util_pct: weighted average GPU utilization across active slots in the pool during the 24h window (0-100%).
- headroom_pct: estimated percent of additional sustained traffic the pool can accept before hitting the SLO-triggered scaling threshold (based on 95th percentile of burst sizes).
- idle_frag_pct: proportion of reserved slots that are unused because of fragmentation (slot-level packing inefficiency).
- active_slots / reserved_slots: observed concurrently active accelerator slots vs configured reservation for the pool.
- p95_latency_ms: inferred tail inference latency at 95th percentile (microbench avg).
- notes: short operational context from the dashboard.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY (top lines):
- APAC cluster apac-3 shows a sustained avg_util_pct of 84% with headroom_pct 6% -> risk window for customer-facing low-latency endpoints during APAC business hours.
- EU cluster eu-2 pool-realtime has fragmentation at 18% after recent slot schema change; recommend compaction job and short-term bump of burst capacity.
- NA cluster na-1 shows several short microbursts (avg_util 62% but p95_latency spikes) suggesting small-batch tail behavior; investigate batching policy on route /v1/stream.

ANOMALY NOTES (detail rows mapped to monitoring alerts):
- ALERT INF-APAC-AUTO-07: apac-3 pool-lowlatency hit autoscale cap twice (2026-08-18 03:20 UTC, 2026-08-18 08:45 UTC). Traces: linked in Linear RT-391. Mitigation: increase max_instances for apac-3 pool-lowlatency to 180 for next 24-48h, and run targeted prefix cache for top-10 heavy customers.
- ALERT INF-EU-FRAG-12: eu-2 pool-realtime fragmentation delta +12% post deploy (pack-v2). Cause suspected: allocation binning change. Mitigation: schedule compaction job (infra-ops compaction-v2) and roll back allocation tweak if no improvement.
- OBSERVATION INF-NA-LAT-23: na-1 p95 latency tail dominated by many small requests; suggest testing batching threshold change from 8->16 tokens and enable kv-prefix cache for streaming routes.

RECOMMENDED ACTIONS (short prioritized checklist):
1) Short term (0-48h): bump apac-3 pool-lowlatency max_instances +20%; enable route-level prefix cache for top-10 keys; schedule emergency compaction for eu-2 pool-realtime.
2) Medium term (1-2 weeks): run fragmentation sweep across pools with >12% idle_frag_pct; evaluate reservation reallocation from na-1 pool-dedicated-commit to apac surge buffer.
3) Long term (1+ month): adjust autoscaler policy to include burst-credit smoothing and per-customer pacing; instrument request-size histogram in streaming routes.

NOTES FOR CAPACITY PLANNERS:
- This export is derived from the Spectroframe OLAP table (infra.util_signals.v1) with these transforms: 1m sample -> 5m rolling avg -> window aggregation (24h). Headroom estimation is conservative (assumes 95th perc burst sustained for 60s).
- For contractual SLA reviews, use the 7-day rolling export (weekly) rather than a single daily snapshot; linking to weekly export: shared_drives/engineering/infrastructure/rolling-utilization-window-summary-2026-04-15.json

APPENDIX (quick debugging pointers):
- Query template for reproducing row: SELECT cluster, pool, AVG(util) as avg_util_pct, PERCENTILE(latency, 0.95) as p95_latency_ms, compute_headroom(...) FROM infra.util_signals WHERE date='2026-08-18' AND cluster='apac-3' GROUP BY cluster, pool;
- Compaction job reference: infra/bin/compaction-runner --pool eu-2 --mode aggressive --dry-run (start with dry-run).

END OF EXPORT
